questions.text: Solve for x: 5x - 7 = 23
questions.explanation: 5x - 7 = 23, so 5x = 30, giving x = 6.

questions.text: What is the value of 3^4?

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Simplify: (2/3) + (1/6)
questions.explanation: Using a common denominator of 6: (2/3 = 4/6) + (1/6) = 5/6.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Find x if 8x + 3 = 5x + 21
questions.explanation: 8x + 3 = 5x + 21, so 3x = 18, giving x = 6.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: What is 35% of 260?

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: The average of 8 numbers is 12. What is their sum?
questions.explanation: Sum = average x count = 12 x 8 = 96.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Solve: x^2 - 25 = 0
questions.explanation: x^2 = 25, so x = sqrt(25) = +-5, giving x = 5 or x = -5.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: If the ratio of male to female students in a class is 3:4 and there are 15 male students, how many female students are there?
questions.explanation: 3 parts = 15, so 1 part = 5. Female students = 4 parts = 4 x 5 = 20.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: What is the perimeter of a square with side length 11cm?
questions.explanation: Perimeter of a square = 4 x side = 4 x 11 = 44cm.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: What is the area of a circle with radius 7cm? (Use pi = 22/7)

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Simplify: 2^3 x 2^4
questions.explanation: When multiplying powers with the same base, add the exponents: 2^3 x 2^4 = 2^7 = 128.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: What is the value of the square root of 169?
questions.explanation: The square root of 169 is 13, since 13 x 13 = 169.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: A commuter travels 120km in 2 hours. What is their average speed?
questions.explanation: Average speed = distance/time = 120/2 = 60 km/h.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Solve for x: (x/5) - 2 = 4

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: What is the sum of the interior angles of a heptagon (7 sides)?
questions.explanation: The sum of interior angles of a polygon = (n-2) x 180, so for a heptagon (n=7): (7-2) x 180 = 900 degrees.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: What is the sum of the interior angles of an octagon (8 sides)?
questions.explanation: Using (n-2) x 180 for an octagon (n=8): (8-2) x 180 = 1080 degrees.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Factorise: x^2 - 9x + 20
questions.explanation: We need two numbers that multiply to 20 and add to -9: -4 and -5. So x^2-9x+20 = (x-4)(x-5).

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: What is 0.75 expressed as a fraction in its lowest terms?
questions.explanation: 0.75 = 75/100, which simplifies to 3/4 when divided by 25.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: If a = 6 and b = -4, find the value of a^2 - b^2

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: What is the median of the data set: 5, 9, 11, 16, 22?
questions.explanation: With 5 values arranged in order (5,9,11,16,22), the median is the middle value: 11.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: What is the mode of the data set: 2, 4, 4, 7, 9, 4, 10?
questions.explanation: The mode is the most frequently occurring value; 4 appears three times, more than any other value.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Convert 3/8 to a percentage.
questions.explanation: 3/8 = 0.375, which as a percentage is 37.5%.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: What is the LCM (Lowest Common Multiple) of 9 and 12?
questions.explanation: Multiples of 9: 9,18,27,36...; multiples of 12: 12,24,36...; the smallest common multiple is 36.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: What is the HCF (Highest Common Factor) of 24 and 36?
questions.explanation: The factors of 24 are 1,2,3,4,6,8,12,24; factors of 36 are 1,2,3,4,6,9,12,18,36; the highest common factor is 12.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: If 4x + 3y = 23 and x = 5, find the value of y.
questions.explanation: Substituting x=5: 4(5) + 3y = 23, so 20 + 3y = 23, giving 3y = 3, so y = 1.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: A trader sells an item for N7,200 after a 10% discount on the original price. What was the original price?
questions.explanation: If N7,200 represents 90% of the original price, then original price = 7,200/0.9 = N8,000.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: What is the next number in the sequence: 2, 6, 18, 54, ___?
questions.explanation: Each term is multiplied by 3 to get the next term: 54 x 3 = 162.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Simplify: (3a^2b) x (5ab^2)
questions.explanation: Multiplying coefficients: 3x5=15. Multiplying a terms: a^2 x a = a^3. Multiplying b terms: b x b^2 = b^3. Result: 15a^3b^3.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: What is the value of x in the equation: 3(x - 2) = 2(x + 4)

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: A rectangular plot has an area of 176 square metres and a width of 11 metres. What is its length?
questions.explanation: Length = Area/Width = 176/11 = 16 metres.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: What is the probability of picking a green ball from a bag containing 3 green and 7 yellow balls?
questions.explanation: Total balls = 3 + 7 = 10. Probability of green = 3/10.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Express 6.3 x 10^2 as an ordinary number.

questions.text: A car depreciates from N2,500,000 to N2,000,000 in one year. What is the percentage depreciation?
